caseName: School District of Pittsburgh v. Department of Education of Pennsylvania
caseNameFull: School District of Pittsburgh v. Department of Education of Pennsylvania and Pequea Valley School District v. Department of Education of Pennsylvania

opinions.text: Appeals from Sup. Ct. Pa. dismissed for want of substantial federal question. Mr. Justice Blackmun, Mr. Justice Powell, and Mr. Justice Stevens would note probable jurisdiction and set cases for oral argument. Reported below: 483 Pa. 539, 397 A. 2d 1154.
